admission.justification: Proved by PyrightScopeConfigurationTests and prevents bare Pyright runs from scanning nested mcp/.venv or dashboard/node_modules for hours or matching tracked .dagger/ Python files in [tool.pyright] exclude.

applicability: Root pyproject.toml [tool.pyright] configuration for bare Pyright and editor runs across the checkout.
conditions: include remains ["."] so the checkout's tracked Python files stay in scope.
Every exclude entry uses a depth-independent **/ pattern and matches zero tracked Python files from git ls-files '*.py'.
exclusions: Blanket dot-folder patterns such as .* or **/.* in [tool.pyright] exclude, because tracked Python files live under .dagger/ (Pyright 1.1.414+'s own default dot-folder exclude applies independently).
Explicit file-list command-line invocations in .githooks/_gate.sh and quality_plan.py, which replace include while still applying exclude.

evidence: Reviewer rerun: focused pytest 42 passed, 4 skipped on candidate tree 6233906597db9e470c437653d63f1c28af37db3b; validate_quality_config OK with 2,594 type paths; live bare Pyright checked 2,594 files with 0 errors; verdict notes/reports/reviewer/7c4e2b91-5a1f-4d8e-b3c2-9f6a1e4d8b37/role-launch/261112-BUG-L49-route-review-verdict.md

mcp/tests/test_code_quality_check_scope.py::PyrightScopeConfigurationTests::test_repo_pyright_config_excludes_nested_environments_and_keeps_tracked_python; validate_quality_config OK (2557 tracked .py on db236f3c6/105bd85c5652, 0 dropped); W1 Reviewer R1 PASS on 6233906597db/395a09500ce1.

statement: Root pyproject.toml [tool.pyright] excludes virtual environments, dependency trees, build outputs, and caches at any depth without a blanket dot-folder pattern so [tool.pyright] exclude matches zero tracked Python files (including .dagger/) and validate_quality_config keeps passing.
title: Root [tool.pyright] excludes nested environments and keeps tracked Python
